motion_correction.method: Re-generated middle preparation, continuous horizontal cut and compact recovery with aligned shoulders/pelvis and unchanged support-foot order. High/low pose pixels and timing remain v11.
motion_correction.source_review: v12 middle waist correction: stable shallow three-quarter torso, aligned shoulder/pelvis facing, same support-foot order and small knee-led loading. Continuous waist-level edge cut uses solid perspective poses; direct front-point lift is sampled backward from a controlled lowering take, then joins the original return take at its matching raised pose 22 and settles to idle. No source-frame body repainting or per-frame recentering. Retains v11 391/96/48/462 ms rhythm; high/low unchanged.

reviewed: Reviewed all new middle source takes and all 38 delivered middle poses on native dark/light sheets and local face, hands, blade, waist, legs and tail views.

Middle preparation, cut and recovery retain a consistent shallow three-quarter body view, aligned shoulder/pelvis facing and stable support-foot order. Removed the previous large waist coil and counter-turn.

Initial full take contributes only stable preparation. Snapped/glowing release and reverse waist sweep are rejected. The first return take contributes only the raised guide and late guard settling; the below-leg loop is excluded.

The direct front-point lift uses explicitly reversed samples of a controlled lowering reference, then joins the matching raised guide before guard settling. Every source index is recorded; no video-frame body repainting or per-frame recentering.
Both rendered facings inspected at windup frame 35, release/contact 45 and recovery 63. Runtime traces verify two complete single attacks per stance and one finish accent each.

build.note: No C# gameplay changes; existing full-build warnings are not claimed fixed.

validation.gameplay: Full STANCE_CHECK passed, including physical left clicks, stance selection, single recovery, particles, generic combo framework, movement, persistence and instance isolation.

limits: No independent full-silhouette masks. Raw audits have zero numeric errors but still require visual review; this does not prove perfect silhouette retention.
Generated contours and blade perspective vary slightly; the character and sword share authored frames rather than a rigid skeletal rig.
Middle matte changes alpha only. The two retained high steel RGB repairs are separately recorded and verified by exact expected-RGBA packaging.
Reference videos were not measured frame by frame; all timing values describe these project clips.
Damage and hit detection are outside this art correction.

Headless tools report system certificate, editor help-cache/RichTextLabel and user MCP registry diagnostics; no missing production resources or parse failures. Rendered shutdown reports rendering RID leak diagnostics. All affected checks and both captures exit normally.
